canonical.title: A Michelin Weekend in San Francisco

children.title: Things to Do in San Francisco
children.summary: What's worth your time in SF — landmarks, neighborhoods, parks, museums, food, and day trips — with prices, booking lead times, and the local worth-it-vs-trap verdict.

children.title: Michelin 2 and 3-Star Restaurants in San Francisco
children.summary: SF has 3 three-star and 7 two-star Michelin restaurants; standouts include Korean-Californian Benu, pescatarian Atelier Crenn, contemporary Mexican Californios, and Nordic newcomer Kiln.

children.title: IT Conferences and Tech Events in San Francisco
children.summary: Month-by-month calendar of 20+ major IT conferences in SF for 2026, from RSA in March to OWASP AppSec in November, with dates, venues, scales, and ticket ranges.
